content: UEFA's 2026-07-16 announcement confirms the EURO 2028 qualifying draw will be in Belfast on Sunday 2026-12-06; it says qualifying uses 12 groups of four or five, begins March 2027, ends November 2027, and play-offs are planned for March 2028. It is the authoritative date reference, while activation still requires a complete accepted draw-and-schedule bundle under project decisions.
